query: I am on no-pay/study/medical/maternity leave. Will I be considered as employed to qualify for Workfare Income Supplement?
reference_answer: For the purpose of Workfare Income Supplement (WIS), staff on study/medical/maternity leave will be considered as employees if you are still receiving a salary and CPF contributions from your employers.
answer: Based on the information available, if you are on no-pay/study, medical, or maternity leave, you may not be considered employed to qualify for Workfare Income Supplement. Qualification typically requires being employed. [Document N] not available for detailed verification.
